name: TreeSelect
description:
A select whose options are a tree: folders, org units, device groups. One node, or with
`multiple` several, with checkboxes whose branches show the mixed state and a
`checkStrategy` for what the value lists. The tree opens on glass below the trigger with
a search field (matches keep their ancestors and are highlighted); lazily loaded branches
use Tree's `onLoadChildren`. Chosen nodes show as chips that fold into "+N".

Keyboard (the ARIA tree pattern): ↓ from the search enters the tree; ↑ ↓ move, → opens or
enters a group, ← closes or returns to the parent, Home / End, Enter or Space chooses (a
single choice closes the tree), typing returns to the search. Backspace on the trigger
removes the last chosen node; Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that provide the accessible name.

props.name: checkStrategy
props.description:
Multiple choice: which checked nodes the value lists. `parent` (default) lists a fully
checked branch instead of its children; `child` lists leaves only; `all` lists every
checked node.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Applied to the trigger.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Groups open at first. Default: the ancestors of the chosen values.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: The line shown when the search matches nothing. Default: No match for “query”.

props.name: groupCounts
props.description: Show each group's count of leaves. Default true; lazily loaded branches never show one.

props.name: icon
props.description: A fixed leading icon in the trigger, for a single choice whose node has none.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid outside a Field.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ placeholder: string; options: string; search: string; noMatch: (query: string) => string; selected: (count: number) => string; more: (count: number, labels: string) => string; clear: string; loading: string; loadFailed: string; retry: string; }> | undefined
props.description: Wording for this instance, over the language pack and `MessagesProvider`.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for search matching and wording. Default: the nearest `LocaleProvider`.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Several nodes, with checkboxes.

props.name: name
props.description: Native form field name: one hidden input per chosen id.

props.name: nodes
props.description: The tree of options: folders, org units, device groups. Ids must be unique.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when focus leaves the trigger while the tree is closed, so a form can mark the field touched.

props.name: onLoadChildren
props.description:
Load a branch's children the first time it opens (a node with `hasChildren` and no
`children`): update `nodes`, then resolve. A rejection shows Retry. Same contract as Tree.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with true when the tree opens and false when it closes.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: ((value: string | null) => void) | ((value: string[]) => void) | undefined
props.description:
Called with the chosen node's id when one is picked by click, Enter or Space.
Called with every checked id (in `checkStrategy` form, tree order) after each check, uncheck or Clear.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is chosen. Name the choice ("Choose a team"), not "Select…".

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a search field above the tree. Default true. Matches keep their ancestors and are highlighted.

props.name: selectableGroups
props.description: Single choice: branches can be chosen as well as opened. Per node with `TreeNode.selectable`.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: value
props.description:
The chosen node's id, or null. Controlled while defined.
The checked ids in `checkStrategy` form, in tree order. Controlled while defined.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: short, medium or full (default).

props.name: wrap
props.description: Multiple choice: let chips wrap onto more lines (forms). Off: one line that folds the rest into "+N".
